rules.title: Maximum payments required at commencement of tenancy
rules.requirement: At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, a lessor or their agent may not require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay any amount exceeding the first full month's rent, last full month's rent (calculated at the first month's rate), a security deposit equal to the first month's rent (or an authorized fee in lieu of a deposit up to one month's rent), and the purchase and installation cost for a key and lock.
rules.key_value: First month's rent, last month's rent, security deposit equal to 1 month's rent (or fee in lieu up to 1 month's rent), and key/lock cost
rules.coverage_conditions: At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy.
rules.exemptions: Any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.title: Subsequent demands for advance rent and security deposit
rules.requirement: A lessor or successor in interest may not demand rent in advance in excess of the current month's rent or a security deposit in excess of statutory limits at any time after the tenancy commences. Advance payments for occupancy are binding on all successors in interest.
rules.coverage_conditions: At any time subsequent to the commencement of a tenancy.
rules.exemptions: Any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.title: Tenant ownership, non-commingling, and creditor protection of security deposits
rules.requirement: A security deposit remains the property of the tenant, must not be commingled with the lessor's assets, and is protected from claims of any creditor of the lessor or the lessor's successor in interest, including foreclosing mortgagees or bankruptcy trustees.
rules.coverage_conditions: Security deposits held under this section.
rules.exemptions: Any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.title: Receipt requirement for advance payment of last month's rent
rules.requirement: A lessor or agent who receives advance rent for the last month of tenancy must provide a receipt at the time of payment stating the amount, date received, intended application, recipient's name (and lessor's name if received by an agent), premises description, statement of tenant's entitlement to interest at 5% per year or lesser bank interest, and a statement that the tenant should provide a forwarding address upon termination.

rules.coverage_conditions: Lessor or agent receiving rent in advance for the last month of tenancy at or prior to commencement of tenancy.
rules.exemptions: Any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of one hundred days or less in duration which lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor or his agent who receives, at or prior to the commencement of a tenancy, rent in advance for the last month of the tenancy from a tenant or prospective tenant shall give to such tenant or prospective tenant at the time of such advance payment a receipt indicating the amount of such rent, the date on which it was received, its intended application as rent for the last month of the tenancy, the name of the person receiving it and, in the case of an agent, the name of the lessor for whom the rent is received, and a description of the rented or leased premises, and a statement indicating that the tenant is entitled to interest on said rent payment at the rate of five per cent per year or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable in accordance with the provisions of this clause, and a statement indicating that the tenant should provide the lessor with a forwarding address at the termination of the tenancy indicating where such interest may be given or sent.

rules.title: Interest payments and statements on advance last month's rent
rules.requirement: A lessor or agent receiving last month's rent in advance must pay interest beginning the first day of tenancy at 5% per year or the lesser amount received from the bank, paid annually or within 30 days of early termination, and provide an annual statement; if interest or deduction notice is not provided within 30 days after the end of each year, the tenant may deduct the interest from the next rent payment.

rules.title: Damages remedy for failure to pay interest on advance last month's rent
rules.requirement: If the lessor fails to pay interest to which the tenant is entitled within 30 days after termination of tenancy, the tenant upon proof in an action shall be awarded damages equal to three times the amount of interest due, plus court costs and reasonable attorney's fees.

rules.title: Transfer of security deposits and notice upon change of ownership
rules.requirement: Upon transferring interest in a dwelling unit, a lessor must transfer held security deposits and accrued interest to the successor in interest; the successor must notify the tenant in writing within 45 days, and if the predecessor fails to transfer the funds, the successor assumes liability (which may be satisfied by free occupancy if the tenant still occupies the unit).
